## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 29, 2026 - Apr 29, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _mat taylor_, Apr 29, 2026, 2/5: "wont register that ive done the foundations of back bends and let me move forward, also cant message anyone on the app to let them know, keep telling me message cant be sent, which is definitely an issue with the app. And like someone else has said, for newbies, things aren't explained very well so theres a lot of rewinding the videos to try and see whats going on."

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: May 12, 2026 - Jul 21, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Rafał Polito_, Jun 2, 2026, 1/5: "After one year eveb when I cancelled subscription they still planned to grab and stole my money, liars!"
            2. _Sanne_, May 12, 2026, 1/5: "Downloaded a test version but didn't like it. Hate the fact that you need to get in some program instead of just do your workouts, like just on travel weeks. Need to fill in so much amd click stuff away. Because the subscription goes from your creditcard (that i hardly use) I never noticed the auto nenewal of (€31,-!!!) per month. Over 300 euro of sponsoring a German ripoff. Well done Asana. *the "solution" after contacting support is that I'm invited to fill in a review form. Great, thnx guys!"
            3. _Angelica Hauca_, Jul 21, 2026, 4/5: "Hi, I've been using the app for a few months. It's helpful if you don't have time and can't get to a gym. The only problem was when renewing the subscription, I didn't receive any notification about it even though I had canceled the subscription in the phone's app store settings. However, it was quickly resolved with the help of the in-app support and I got my money back. Thank you!"
